newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Delta Lloyd sees 1997 net at least equal to 1996.
newsitem.headline: Delta Lloyd sees 1997 net at least equal to 1996.

text.p: Delta Lloyd Verzekeringsgroep NV, Dutch unit of Commercial Union, said on Wednesday it expected 1997 net profit at least to equal that of 1996.
"Barring unforeseen circumstances we expect that post-tax profits will be at least equal to the level of 1996," it said.
Delta Lloyd earlier announced a 1996 net profit of 327.9 million guilders, an increase of 11.3 percent over 1995.
Delta Lloyd said it was planning to introduce several new products in 1997.
"For this reason we foresee a stronger increase in turnover than in the recent period," it said.
The company said it would maintain its policy of refusing to accept losses on its products in order to expand market share.
The group's turnover rose to 5.18 billion guilders in 1996 versus 4.86 billion in 1995.
